title: incident-bot: integrate SLO-toolkit utilities into oncall diagnostics and runbook suggestions
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Integrates SLO-toolkit heuristics into incident-bot oncall diagnostics and runbook ranking; adds new oncall helper utilities and docs. No user-facing API changes.
description: Motivation: oncall engineers rely on incident-bot to surface relevant runbooks and diagnostic hints during SLO incidents. Current heuristics weight runbooks primarily by tag and historical clicks which misses SLO-context signals (error budget remaining, burn rate, recent regressions). This change integrates SLO-toolkit utilities into incident-bot to provide SLO-aware scoring, tie runbook suggestions to specific SLO signals, and expose a small set of oncall helpers for rapid context inspection. Summary of changes: added SLO-score feature extractor, runbook scorer using SLO-toolkit heuristics, new oncall helper endpoints for 'show-slo-context' and 'suggest-runbooks', unit and integration tests, and docs updates. Checklist: - Implement SLO extractor and scorer; - Wire scorer into incident-bot suggestion pipeline with a configurable weight; - Add feature flag to roll out to 10% of oncall traffic initially; - Add tests and telemetry (metric: incident_bot.runbook_suggestions.slo_weight); - Docs: update oncall runbook guide with examples. Design notes: SLO-toolkit exposes a small utilities module (slo_toolkit.utils.slo_features) which we import and call with the incident summary to compute features like current_error_budget_pct, burn_rate_windowed, recent_regressions_count. The scorer is additive: base_score + alpha * slo_score where alpha is a runtime-configurable knob in incident-bot config with default 0.3. Rollout: feature-flagged on incident-bot and gated by a config flag in the control plane; staged rollout to 10% then 50% then 100% with monitoring of precision/recall on runbook acceptance by oncall. Backwards compatibility: when feature flag is off, incident-bot behavior is unchanged. Security and perf: calls to the SLO toolkit are local in-process and memoized per-incident to avoid extra latency; added a 200ms budget in end-to-end path and async fallback to base scoring if extractor times out. Testing: added unit tests for extractor and scorer, integration tests that exercise the feature flag and fallback, and a lightweight e2e smoke test that runs in staging. Observability: new metrics and logs added; dashboards will be created separately (ENG-3215).

post_merge_steps: 1) Monitor metric incident_bot.runbook_suggestions.slo_weight and incident_bot.slo_integration.failures for 48h; 2) Gradually increase rollout flag from 10% to 100% if no regressions; 3) Publish updated oncall runbook dashboard linking new metrics (ENG-3215); 4) Backfill documentation to internal runbooks index.
notes: This PR is primarily an operational tooling enhancement; no customer-facing API change. It enables future work on automated SLO-driven auto-remediation and tighter coupling between runbook ranking and SLO impact analysis.
